definitions.explanation: Indicates that one thing changes as another changes.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}が{経|た}つに{連|つ}れて{慣|な}れてきた。
examples.english: As time passed, I got used to it.

examples.japanese: {年|とし}を{取|と}るに{連|つ}れて{体力|たいりょく}が{落|お}ちる。
examples.english: As you age, your physical strength declines.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}が{変|か}わるに{連|つ}れて{景色|けしき}も{変|か}わる。
examples.english: As the seasons change, the scenery changes too.

examples.japanese: {練習|れんしゅう}を{重|かさ}ねるに{連|つ}れて、だんだん{上手|じょうず}になってきた。
examples.english: As I practiced more and more, I gradually got better.

examples.japanese: {技術|ぎじゅつ}が{進|すす}むに{連|つ}れて、{生活|せいかつ}は{便利|べんり}になったが、{新|あたら}しい{問題|もんだい}も{生|う}まれている。
examples.english: As technology advances, life has become more convenient, but new problems have also emerged.

notes:
〜に{連|つ}れて is a grammatical expression indicating that two things change in parallel or proportion.

PATTERN:
[Verb dictionary form] + に{連|つ}れて = 'as [verb happens]'

COMMON EXAMPLES:
- {時間|じかん}が{経|た}つに{連|つ}れて: as time passes
- {年|とし}を{取|と}るに{連|つ}れて: as one ages
- {季節|きせつ}が{変|か}わるに{連|つ}れて: as the seasons change
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}が{進|すす}むに{連|つ}れて: as technology advances

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- 〜に{従|したが}って: as, in accordance with (often for rules/trends)
- 〜とともに: together with, along with (simultaneous change)
- 〜につれ: shortened form (more literary)

NOTE:
This is different from {連|つ}れて{行|い}く (to take someone along), which comes from the verb {連|つ}れる (to take/bring a person).
